EasyList and EasyPrivacy

attributed as the source of the material.

Attribution: The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/).

The app bundles easylist.txt and easyprivacy.txt unmodified, as published at
https://easylist.to/easylist/easylist.txt and
https://easylist.to/easylist/easyprivacy.txt, and downloads newer versions of
the same files from those addresses. The lists are data the app reads; it
converts them to WebKit content rules on the device.
